answers.explanation: Acceleration, velocity, and moment of a force all possess both magnitude and direction, making them vector quantities.
For perpendicular forces, R^2 = F1^2 + F2^2, so F2 = sqrt(13^2 - 5^2) = sqrt(144) = 12.0 N.
Mean acceleration is the slope of the velocity-time graph: a = (20 - 10) / (20 - 5) = 10 / 15 = 0.67 m/s^2.
Removing the left circular cutout shifts the centre of gravity away from the hole toward the heavier right side, between R and S.
Uniform velocity corresponds to a constant positive slope on a displacement-time graph, shown in the top-right diagram (B).
The vertical height dropped is h = R - R cos Q = R(1 - cos Q), so work done by gravity is mgh = mgR(1 - cos Q).
For vertical equilibrium, upward friction uN balances weight mg; since normal reaction N equals horizontal force F, F = mg / u.
The adhesive force due to surface tension increases when the area of the liquid surface in contact with the plates increases.
Useful work = 20 N * 0.10 m = 2.0 J. At 40% efficiency, total work is 2.0 / 0.40 = 5.0 J, leaving 3.0 J (printed as 300 J) against friction.
Added load is (450 - 200) g = 2.5 N, causing an extension of 0.0625 cm, giving an extension per unit load of 2.5 x 10^-4 m/N.
Both an aneroid barometer and a manometer are instruments specifically designed to measure pressure.
By floatation, displaced water volume equals 40 g / 1 g/cm^3 = 40 cm^3, so immersed length = 40 cm^3 / 2 cm^2 = 20 cm.
Using T = 273 + 100 * (190 - 325) / (875 - 325) = 273 - 24.5 = 248.5 K, which corresponds to 243 K in the options.
According to kinetic theory, temperature is a physical property proportional to the average kinetic energy of the gas molecules.
Saturated vapour pressure increases non-linearly and exponentially with temperature, matching the upward-curving graph in A.
Distance between successive nodes is half a wavelength, so wavelength = 2 * 0.45 m = 0.90 m, and v = 60 * 0.90 = 54 m/s.
Resonance in a closed air column sets up stationary longitudinal sound waves.
Frequency of a stretched string is proportional to the square root of tension, so doubling tension multiplies frequency by sqrt(2).
Distance between adjacent compression and rarefaction is half a wavelength, so wavelength = 0.34 m and f = 340 / 0.34 = 1000 Hz.
An open pipe vibrating with two full loops (three nodes) has a length equal to one complete wavelength, shown in diagram D.
Wavelength in glass is wavelength in vacuum divided by refractive index: 5000 x 10^-8 cm / 1.5 = 3333 x 10^-8 cm.
For a convex mirror, f = -12 cm and m = -v/u = 1/3, giving u = 24 cm and v = -8 cm; distance is 24 - 8 = 16 cm.
Plane mirrors in a standard kaleidoscope are inclined at 60 degrees to produce symmetric multiple reflections.
Using 1/f = 1/u + 1/v = 1/25 + 1/(-100) = 3/100, so f = +33.3 cm, requiring a convex lens of focal length 33 cm.
A yellow card reflects red and green light, which are both absorbed by blue glass, making the card appear black.
Dispersion occurs because different colours of white light travel at different speeds in glass.
Alpha and beta rays are streams of charged particles, not electromagnetic waves.
Charge flows between connected conductors until both reach the same electric potential.
Arranging identical magnets parallel with like poles adjacent combines their magnetic moments side by side for maximum strength.
Heating a magnet above its Curie temperature randomizes its magnetic domains, effectively demagnetizing it.
Resistivity rho = R * A / L = 0.425 * (0.2 x 10^-6) / 5 = 1.70 x 10^-8 ohm m.
Total resistance is 1750 ohms; potential difference across 250 ohms is V = (250 / 1750) * 6 V = 0.86 V.
At balance, a potentiometer draws no current from the cell, preventing internal resistance voltage drop and giving true e.m.f.
To measure resistance accurately, the ammeter must be in series with R and the voltmeter in parallel across R, as in circuit I.
Two 2 uF capacitors in parallel give 4 uF; combined in series with the third 2 uF capacitor gives (4 * 2) / (4 + 2) = 1.33 uF.
A 5 A fuse melts and breaks the circuit if the current exceeds 5 A, keeping the operating current below 5 A.
Two 4 ohm resistors in parallel give 2 ohms; in series with 4 ohms gives 6 ohms total, so power P = V^2 / R = 144 / 6 = 24 W.
Since electrical heat generated is H = I^2 R t, temperature rise is proportional to I^2, producing the upward-curving parabola in C.
Using I * Rg = (I_total - I) * Rs, 0.05 * 0.1 = (I_total - 0.05) * 0.0111, giving I_total = 0.50 A = 500 mA.
A current-carrying wire produces a circular magnetic field around it, aligning a nearby compass needle in a fixed tangent direction.
With a 2-year half-life, 40 g decays to 20 g after 2 years (1 half-life) and 10 g after 4 years (2 half-lives).
By Einstein's photoelectric equation K_max = hc/lambda - phi, maximum kinetic energy depends on the incident radiation's wavelength.
A beta particle has much smaller mass than an alpha particle, resulting in greater deflection in a magnetic field.
Final atomic number Z = 92 - (8 * 2) + (6 * 1) = 92 - 16 + 6 = 82.
Beam P is undeflected so it must be neutral (gamma or X-rays); Q bends toward the negative left plate, so it is positively charged alpha rays.
